Cloud Computer 不支持从 OpenLink 修改旧消息；原消息与历: Cloud Computer does not support editing old messages from OpenLink; the original message and history are preserved.
VTSLX 连接需要重新授权。请先在 Cloud 设置中断开旧连接，再回来重新连: The VTSLX connection needs to be authorized again. Disconnect the old connection in Cloud settings, then come back and reconnect.
先在 Hydite Studio 创建组织和项目，回来刷新列表后即可继续。: Create an organization and project in Hydite Studio first, then come back and refresh the list to continue.
先连接 Hydite 账号，OpenLink 会通过 VTSLX SDK 读取你: Connect your Hydite account first. OpenLink uses the VTSLX SDK to read the projects you can access in Studio.
创建组织、使用邀请码加入，或继续使用个人工作区。: Create an organization, join with an invite code, or continue with your personal workspace.
已连接 VTSLX 账号，但暂时无法访问所选项目的 Computer，请刷新后重: VTSLX is connected, but the selected project's Computer is not accessible right now. Refresh and try again.
暂时无法关联该 Studio 项目，请稍后重试。: Unable to link this Studio project right now. Please try again later.
暂时无法读取 Studio 项目，请检查 VTSLX 连接后重试。: Unable to read Studio projects right now. Check the VTSLX connection and try again.
暂时无法连接 VTSLX，请稍后重试。: Unable to connect to VTSLX right now. Please try again later.
此项目选择仅适用于 Cloud 模式。: This project selection is only available in Cloud mode.
确认你的昵称，并建立个人工作区。组织空间可以稍后添加。: Confirm your nickname and set up your personal workspace. You can add organization spaces later.
确认你的昵称，用于 OpenLink 中的个人显示；下一步将从 Studio 选: Confirm the nickname shown for you in OpenLink; next you will choose a project from Studio.
组织与项目由 Hydite Studio 管理；创建完成后回到这里刷新项目列表。: Organizations and projects are managed by Hydite Studio. Once created, return here and refresh the project list.
该 Studio 项目当前账号不可访问，请刷新列表后重试。: This Studio project is not accessible to the current account. Refresh the list and try again.
选择一个已有项目关联到 OpenLink，或前往 Hydite Studio 创: Choose an existing project to link to OpenLink, or create an organization/project in Hydite Studio and return to refresh the list.
选择要关联到 OpenLink 个人项目的 Studio 项目。: Choose the Studio project to link to your OpenLink personal project.
项目关联状态已变化，请刷新页面后重试。: The project link state changed. Refresh the page and try again.
